lines.zh: 我顺着河水的方向游，鳍一张一合。
lines.en: I swim with the river, my fins opening and closing.

lines.zh: 蓝色的小身子在水草间闪了一下。
lines.en: My small blue body flashes once between the waterweeds.

lines.zh: 我顶着额前的角，撞开漂浮的叶子。
lines.en: I push with the horn on my brow and knock floating leaves aside.

lines.zh: 我和同伴排成一条线，逆着水流。
lines.en: My schoolmates and I line up against the current.

lines.zh: 河底的石子硌不到我，我游得高一点。
lines.en: The riverbed pebbles cannot touch me; I swim a little higher.

lines.zh: 我摆一下尾巴，拐进芦苇的影子里。
lines.en: One flick of my tail, and I turn into the reed shadows.

lines.zh: 转弯的时候，我的角总慢半拍。
lines.en: When I turn, my horn always lags half a beat behind.

lines.zh: 一群蓝色的小东西从你脚边掠过。
lines.en: A cluster of small blue things streaks past your feet.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面游，偶尔碰到自己的倒影。
lines.en: I swim at the surface and sometimes bump my own reflection.

lines.zh: 水流推我，我用鳍把它顶回去。
lines.en: The current pushes me, and my fins push right back.

lines.zh: 从沙洲这头到那头，只要一小会儿。
lines.en: From one end of the sandbar to the other takes no time.

lines.zh: 河面结着薄冰，我在下面照样游。
lines.en: Thin ice covers the river, and I swim beneath it anyway.

lines.zh: 我跟着一片落叶走了很远。
lines.en: I follow a single fallen leaf for a long way.

lines.zh: 队列散开又合上，我们从不落后。
lines.en: The line scatters and reforms; none of us falls behind.

lines.zh: 我跟着同伴拐进浅滩。
lines.en: I follow my kin into the shallows.

lines.zh: 我顶着水草，从它下面钻过去。
lines.en: I nose the weed and slip beneath it.

lines.zh: 我停在河湾里，让水从鳃边流过。
lines.en: I hover in the river bend and let the water pass my gills.

lines.zh: 阳光照到蓝鳞上，晃成一片。
lines.en: Sunlight hits my blue scales and shimmers into a blur.

lines.zh: 同伴就在旁边，我们谁都不动。
lines.en: My schoolmates are right beside me, and none of us moves.

lines.zh: 我的角其实不硬，只是长得像。
lines.en: My horn is not actually hard; it only looks the part.

lines.zh: 有根水草缠在鳍上，我没去理。
lines.en: A weed wraps around my fin, and I ignore it.

lines.zh: 河底的青蛙看了我一眼，跳走了。
lines.en: A frog on the riverbed glances at me and hops away.

lines.zh: 我悬浮着，尾巴懒懒地摆。
lines.en: I hang suspended, tail swaying lazily.

lines.zh: 水面上的脚步声，让我停了一下。
lines.en: Footsteps at the surface make me pause.

lines.zh: 我用角蹭了蹭河底的石头。
lines.en: I rub my horn against a stone on the riverbed.

lines.zh: 水里有泡泡升上去，我跟着看。
lines.en: Bubbles rise through the water, and I watch them go.

lines.zh: 群里的鱼都安静，我也不出声。
lines.en: The school is quiet, and I make no sound either.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来，享受水流的凉。
lines.en: I turn on my side and enjoy the cool of the current.

lines.zh: 河湾很浅，我待着很舒服。
lines.en: This bend is shallow, and I am comfortable here.

lines.zh: 我就这样漂着，什么也不打算做。
lines.en: I just drift like this, with no plans at all.

lines.zh: 你蹲在岸边，我就游过来看一眼。
lines.en: You crouch on the bank, so I swim over for a look.

lines.zh: 你的影子投进水里，我抬头找你。
lines.en: Your shadow falls into the water, and I look up for you.

lines.zh: 我隔着水看你，你也在看我。
lines.en: I look at you through the water, and you look back.

lines.zh: 我绕着你泡在水里的脚转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the foot you have soaking in the river.

lines.zh: 你手里的桶让我有点在意。
lines.en: That bucket in your hand concerns me a little.

lines.zh: 你的手指点了一下水面，我退了半格。
lines.en: Your finger taps the surface, and I back off half a block.

lines.zh: 我把角对着你，其实只是好奇。
lines.en: I point my horn at you, though it is only curiosity.

lines.zh: 你弯腰看水时，我正贴在你脚边。
lines.en: While you bend to look, I am right by your feet.

lines.zh: 你身上没有鱼腥味，我在想那是什么。
lines.en: You do not smell of fish, and I wonder what that scent is.

lines.zh: 你和我，就隔着一层水面。
lines.en: You and I are separated by nothing but water.

lines.zh: 我被撞得翻了个身，鳞掉了一片。
lines.en: I am knocked onto my side and lose a scale.

lines.zh: 疼，我立刻往水草里钻。
lines.en: It hurts, and I dive straight into the weeds.

lines.zh: 我的角磕在桶壁上，嗡了一下。
lines.en: My horn knocks the bucket wall and rings.

lines.zh: 这一下让我整群都散了。
lines.en: That blow scatters my entire school.

lines.zh: 我只有两点生命，经不起第二下。
lines.en: I have only two health points and cannot take another.

lines.zh: 我歪着游，鳍动得很乱。
lines.en: I swim crooked, my fins moving all wrong.

lines.zh: 水里的血味让我害怕。
lines.en: The smell of blood in the water frightens me.

lines.zh: 我贴在河底不动，希望你看不见。
lines.en: I press to the riverbed and hope you cannot see me.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴少了一小块，游起来偏。
lines.en: A piece of my tail is gone, and I swim off course.

lines.zh: 别再来一次，我会躲进石头缝。
lines.en: Do not do that again; I will hide in a stone crack.

lines.zh: 你撒下的面包屑，我游过去啄了一口。
lines.en: I swim over and peck at the breadcrumbs you scattered.

lines.zh: 那点碎食在水里散开，整群都来了。
lines.en: The crumbs spread through the water, and the whole school comes.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的手走，直到水变浅。
lines.en: I follow your hand until the water turns shallow.

lines.zh: 有虫子落水，我比同伴快了一步。
lines.en: A bug falls in, and I beat my schoolmates to it.

lines.zh: 你想用食物引我进桶？我考虑一下。
lines.en: Lure me into the bucket with food? Let me think about it.

lines.zh: 我围着那片鱼饵转，不吃也不走。
lines.en: I circle the bait, neither eating nor leaving.

lines.zh: 水的味道变了，我就知道有吃的。
lines.en: The water changes taste, and I know food is near.

lines.zh: 我一慌就散，一有吃的就回来。
lines.en: I scatter when startled and come back when there is food.

lines.zh: 你的掌心在水里摊开，我碰了一下。
lines.en: Your palm opens underwater, and I bump it once.

lines.zh: 我把食物吞掉，然后立刻忘掉你。
lines.en: I swallow the food and forget you immediately.

lines.zh: 你从水里走过，撞散了我们这群。
lines.en: You wade through the water and break up our school.

lines.zh: 我从你腿边擦过，鳞片刮得很快。
lines.en: I brush past your leg, scales scraping quickly.

lines.zh: 我的角顶到你的脚踝，不疼，但你会低头。
lines.en: My horn bumps your ankle; it does not hurt, but you look down.

lines.zh: 群里的鱼挤在一起，我被推向前。
lines.en: The school presses together, and I am pushed forward.

lines.zh: 你迈步激起的浪，把我推开半格。
lines.en: The wave from your stride shoves me back half a block.

lines.zh: 我们撞上你的网兜，又四散游走。
lines.en: We hit your net and scatter in every direction.

lines.zh: 我撞到河底的石子，转了个方向。
lines.en: I hit a pebble on the riverbed and turn away.

lines.zh: 你蹲下时，我的鼻子碰到你的膝盖。
lines.en: When you crouch, my snout touches your knee.

lines.zh: 整群涌过来，你站在中间像块礁石。
lines.en: The whole school surges past; you stand there like a reef.

lines.zh: 我一头撞在桶壁上，弹了回去。
lines.en: I ram the bucket wall headfirst and bounce back.

lines.zh: 我用角轻轻顶她的侧腹，她没躲。
lines.en: I nudge her flank gently with my horn, and she does not flinch.

lines.zh: 春天水暖，我们靠近得比平时近。
lines.en: The spring water warms, and we swim closer than usual.

lines.zh: 我们并排贴着河底的沙，尾巴一起摆。
lines.en: We lie side by side on the sand, tails swaying together.

lines.zh: 她比我蓝，我想这没什么不好。
lines.en: She is bluer than I am, which seems fine to me.

lines.zh: 交配时整群散开，给我们留了位置。
lines.en: The school spreads out and leaves us a space.

lines.zh: 我在她身边绕圈，鳍尽量张开。
lines.en: I circle her with my fins spread as wide as they go.

lines.zh: 卵会粘在水草背面，谁也看不出来。
lines.en: The eggs will cling behind the waterweeds, hidden from all.

lines.zh: 她游走前，用角碰了我一下。
lines.en: Before she leaves, she touches me once with her horn.

lines.zh: 我守着那片水草，直到卵孵化。
lines.en: I guard those waterweeds until the eggs hatch.

lines.zh: 我们这一群，都是这样生下来的。
lines.en: Our whole school was born this way.

lines.zh: 有粒沙卡在我鳍里，我甩了甩。
lines.en: A grain of sand catches in my fin, so I shake it out.

lines.zh: 一片花瓣落在水面，我顶了一下。
lines.en: A petal lands on the surface, and I butt it once.

lines.zh: 我叼住漂来的小枝，很快又吐掉。
lines.en: I nip a drifting twig, then spit it out quickly.

lines.zh: 你掉的骨粉落进河里，我绕着它转。
lines.en: Your dropped bone meal sinks into the river, and I circle it.

lines.zh: 我没什么能拿的，鳍不是手。
lines.en: There is not much I can carry; fins are not hands.

lines.zh: 一块石子沉下来，我用角把它推开。
lines.en: A pebble sinks down, and I push it aside with my horn.

lines.zh: 我试着咬住水草，结果扯断了一截。
lines.en: I try to hold a waterweed and end up tearing a piece off.

lines.zh: 那东西太沉，我的嘴张不了那么大。
lines.en: That thing is too heavy, and my mouth does not open that wide.

lines.zh: 我捡起来又松开，水流就把它带走。
lines.en: I pick it up, let go, and the current carries it off.

lines.zh: 叼着东西游泳，对我来说很费劲。
lines.en: Swimming with something in my mouth is hard work.

lines.zh: 我没有要攻击谁，我只是看看。
lines.en: I am not attacking anyone; I am only looking.

lines.zh: 有只水蜘蛛划过水面，我盯了一会儿。
lines.en: A water strider skims the surface, and I watch it a while.

lines.zh: 更大的鱼靠近，我带着群钻进芦苇。
lines.en: A bigger fish nears, so I lead the school into the reeds.

lines.zh: 我注意到动静，但角不负责打架。
lines.en: I notice the movement, but my horn is not for fighting.

lines.zh: 你伸手进来，我转过身对着你。
lines.en: You reach into the water, and I turn to face you.

lines.zh: 我把群挡在身后，自己停在前面。
lines.en: I put the school behind me and stay in front.

lines.zh: 目标？我只想让这一群都活着。
lines.en: A target? I only want this school to stay alive.

lines.zh: 一只鹭的影子掠过，我们全沉下去。
lines.en: A heron's shadow passes, and we all sink.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，判断那是不是危险。
lines.en: I lift my head and judge whether that is danger.

lines.zh: 我游得慢，所以从不主动惹事。
lines.en: I swim slowly, so I never start trouble.

lines.zh: 我一直看着你，鳍停住了。
lines.en: I keep watching you, and my fins stop moving.

lines.zh: 你只要不动，我就敢靠近。
lines.en: As long as you stay still, I dare come closer.

lines.zh: 我绕着你游，保持着一点距离。
lines.en: I circle you, keeping a little distance.

lines.zh: 我的角对着你，这是我最凶的样子。
lines.en: My horn points at you; this is as fierce as I get.

lines.zh: 你若伸手，我就退进深一点的水。
lines.en: If you reach out, I withdraw to deeper water.

lines.zh: 群里都在等我先动。
lines.en: The whole school waits for me to move first.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手指，那里最容易抓鱼。
lines.en: I stare at your fingers; they are the likeliest to grab fish.

lines.zh: 水流告诉我，你还没有走。
lines.en: The current tells me you have not left.

lines.zh: 我悬在你面前，不进也不退。
lines.en: I hang before you, neither advancing nor retreating.

lines.zh: 我们就这么对着，直到你先眨眼。
lines.en: We face off until you blink first.

lines.zh: 我用角撞你，你大概只会觉得痒。
lines.en: I butt you with my horn; you will probably just feel a tickle.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，只在你手指上留个浅印。
lines.en: I bite once and leave only a faint mark on your finger.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，我自己都知道。
lines.en: That blow was weak, and I know it.

lines.zh: 我朝你的脚踝撞过去，然后被弹开。
lines.en: I charge your ankle and get bounced away.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿很小，只能咬碎水草。
lines.en: My teeth are small and only good for shredding weeds.

lines.zh: 你笑了，我知道我不构成威胁。
lines.en: You laugh, and I know I am no threat.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴拍水，溅你一脸。
lines.en: My tail whips the water and throws a splash in your face.

lines.zh: 撞完我立刻游开，躲进水草。
lines.en: After the bump I dart off and hide in the weeds.

lines.zh: 我就两点生命，实在打不了架。
lines.en: With two health points, I truly cannot fight.

lines.zh: 这一击用尽了我全部的勇气。
lines.en: That strike used all the courage I have.

lines.zh: 我在河湾的浅水里孵化，第一眼是水草。
lines.en: I hatch in a shallow bend; the first thing I see is weed.

lines.zh: 这一群有十几条，我排在中间。
lines.en: The school numbers a dozen or so, and I am in the middle.

lines.zh: 河水刚涨过，我就跟着来了。
lines.en: The river just rose, and I came along with it.

lines.zh: 我出生时角还是软的，撞不动石头。
lines.en: My horn was soft at birth and could not dent a stone.

lines.zh: 蓝鳞在阳光里亮了一下，我游开了。
lines.en: My blue scales glint in the sun, and I swim off.

lines.zh: 河流群系的水，养得起我们这一群。
lines.en: River water can feed a school like ours.

lines.zh: 我从沙底钻出来，尾巴还带着泥。
lines.en: I wiggle out of the sand with mud still on my tail.

lines.zh: 这条河很小，但够我们住。
lines.en: This river is small, but it is enough for us.

lines.zh: 我跟着前面的鱼，不知道要去哪。
lines.en: I follow the fish ahead without knowing where we go.

lines.zh: 群里的第一条鱼动了，剩下的都跟上。
lines.en: The first fish moves, and the rest follow.

lines.zh: 水面被火烤热了，我往最凉的地方沉。
lines.en: The fire heats the surface, so I sink to the coolest place.

lines.zh: 我被甩出水面，摔在岸上，鳞磕掉几片。
lines.en: I am flung from the water onto the bank and lose several scales.

lines.zh: 我离开水太久，鳃一张一合地疼。
lines.en: Too long out of water, and every flap of my gills aches.

lines.zh: 爆炸把河水掀起来，我被冲上了岸。
lines.en: The blast lifts the river and washes me ashore.

lines.zh: 箭射进河里，削掉我背鳍一角。
lines.en: An arrow shoots into the river and clips the tip of my fin.

lines.zh: 魔法的光罩住我，我整条鱼都僵了。
lines.en: Magic light wraps me, and my whole body goes stiff.

lines.zh: 河里没有吃的了，我的肚子贴着骨头。
lines.en: No food is left in the river, and my belly presses to bone.

lines.zh: 雷落进河湾，整群都翻起了白肚。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the bend, and the whole school turns belly-up.

lines.zh: 河底裂开，我掉进没有水的黑里。
lines.en: The riverbed splits, and I fall into a waterless dark.
